canada.title: Manitoba First Nation taking federal government, department to court over damage to sturgeon population
canada.summary: A remote Manitoba First Nation is taking the federal government to court over claims a Manitoba Hydro project is hurting the sturgeon population in the lower Churchill River.

canada.title: Alberta premier to speak to media Wednesday after strong support for 'remain' in referendum
canada.summary: Alberta Premier Danielle Smith will speak to the media Wednesday morning in Calgary. This follows her televised address Tuesday evening, where she spoke about the results of the Alberta referendum.

canada.title: ‘That’s crazy’: Legendary environmentalist David Suzuki speaks out against Braford’s plan for Toronto’s water
canada.summary: In a passionate speech, Suzuki said "water is priceless and it should be sacred," appealing to Torontonians to vote to protect it.

canada.title: Ontario cancer patients speak out over disappointment with drug funding decision
canada.summary: Some Ontarians with Stage 4 cancer, whose doctors say they are good candidates for treatments unavailable in the province, were buoyed last month when a man won a court challenge against his OHIP out-of-country denial. But their hopes were dashed when Health Minister Sylvia Jones responded to the court ruling by changing the rules.

canada.title: First Nations say Elections Alberta unprepared for referendum turnout
canada.summary: First Nations in Alberta are celebrating the win for the pro-Canada side in Monday's referendum but also raising concerns about a shortage of ballots in their communities.

canada.title: Appeal of an N.S. RCMP officer’s sexual assault acquittal has been abandoned by Crown
canada.summary: An appeal of a Nova Scotia RCMP officer's sexual assault charge acquittal has been abandoned by the Crown.

canada.title: Winnipeg-based rescue techs parachuted into Wainwright after deadly military base fire
canada.summary: Nearly a dozen search and rescue personnel from Winnipeg were among those deployed to Alberta when a deadly fire engulfed a training exercise at CFB Wainwright on Saturday.

canada.title: Psychologists group calls for repeal of regulatory legislation ahead of B.C. election
canada.summary: A coalition of B.C.-based psychologists wants the province to repeal and replace its Health Professions and Occupations Act, which took effect earlier this year, and is asking MLA candidates to make their stance known before the provincial election.

canada.title: Province directs Vitalité to send nurses filling ER vacancies back to primary care
canada.summary: Vitalité Health Network says it still needs help in an understaffed emergency room in northern N.B., despite the province telling it to return nurses it pulled from primary care back to their roles.

canada.title: Report highly critical of RCMP handling of industrial drowning
canada.summary: Civilian Review and Complaints Commission criticizes RCMP investigation into the drowning death of Andrew Gnazdowsky in October 2020.

canada.title: How do B.C.'s major parties plan to tackle toxic drugs and addictions treatment?
canada.summary: B.C.'s major parties vying for your vote this provincial election cycle have made a range of promises to improve access to treatment, and slow the ovedose crisis that has devastated the province for a decade.

canada.title: Yellowknife councillor-elect decries 'toxic' use of social media this election. He's not alone
canada.summary: Steve Payne calls the anonymous posting cowardly and he isn't alone in his concerns. Other candidates and political watchers noted that this campaign was particularly hateful online.

canada.title: Young anglophones are still leaving Quebec, but at much lower rates, find researchers
canada.summary: Having grown up in an English-speaking family in Montreal, Jeremy Schachter says the question of staying or leaving Quebec was a “very real” dinner-table conversation.

canada.title: Hamilton steel-maker delays toxic cleanup, again — this time, the reason is U.S. tariffs
canada.summary: Citing economic pressure from President Donald Trump’s trade war, ArcellorMittal Dofasco has stalled cleaning up its Hamilton Harbour pollution

canada.title: Owner of Saskatoon's stalled 3-storey house calls learning of zoning violations 'devastating'
canada.summary: The owner of a Saskatoon house that violates height restrictions recounted the strain the situation has placed on his family to a board reviewing the predicament Tuesday.

canada.title: Encampments to be part of this year's point-in-time homelessness count in Prince Albert
canada.summary: Last year's Prince Albert point-in-time homeless count found 279 people were living on the street. Organizers estimate the numbers will be even higher this year, as the annual survey will now include people living in homeless encampments throughout the city.

canada.title: N.W.T. finance minister says no emergency relief from fuel price shock, but pushes Ottawa for support
canada.summary: MLAs pressed Finance Minister Caroline Wawzonek Tuesday for immediate measures to confront a potential surge in winter heating bills and the rising cost of living in the North.

canada.title: Did an unasked question cost N.B. Power customers $158 million?
canada.summary: N.B. Power has been criticized by its regulator for not asking enough questions about $158 million in potential savings on a major generator repair at the Point Lepreau Nuclear Generating Station that customers are now responsible to pay.
